original completely untouched. Unlike `edit_message` with `Fork`, no
truncation is performed — the entire history is carried over so the user can
continue a fresh conversation from exactly where they left off.

Content Security Policy metadata for MCP Apps
Specifies allowed domains for network connections and resource loading

resourceDomains.description: Domains allowed for resource loading (scripts, styles, images, fonts, media)

DailyActivity.description: One calendar day of usage, for the Home heatmap.

level.description: 1–4. Level 0 days are omitted from the response entirely.

messages.description: Assistant + user messages exchanged that day.

sessions.description: Sessions *started* that day (exact; keyed on the immutable `created_at`).

tokens.description: Tokens processed that day, summed from per-turn `token_events`.

default_model.description: A recommended default chat model, when one could be determined.

extra_config.description: Non-secret config to persist alongside the key (e.g. a regional host).

models.description: All model ids the provider reported for the key (empty on failure).

provider_name.description: The detected provider, or `null` when detection failed.

reason.description:
Machine-readable failure reason when `provider_name` is null:
`"timeout" | "network" | "invalid_key" | "no_match"`.

name.description:
Optional name for the diverged session. When omitted or blank, the
diverged session inherits the original session's name so it stays
recognizable in the session list.

truncateAfter.description:
Optional anchor: the `created` timestamp (ms) of the assistant message a
per-message Diverge button was clicked on. The branch is trimmed to end
at that answer. When omitted, the branch ends at the most recent
complete assistant answer — an in-flight turn captured mid-generation is
never carried over.

divergedFrom.description: The id of the session this one was diverged from (its lineage parent).

sessionId.description: The id of the newly-created diverged session.

workingDir.description:
The working directory of the diverged session (identical to the
original). Surfaced so the client can spawn the new window/backend in
the correct directory.

additionalProperties.description: A map of environment variables to set, e.g. API_KEY -> some_secret, HOST -> host

ModelUsageRow.description:
One `(model, provider)` group of the per-model usage breakdown.

`model_id` / `provider` are `None` for turns recorded before model
attribution landed, or when the provider reported no model — those rows
aggregate together as the "unknown" group.

turns.description: Number of billed turns attributed to this group.

frontmatter.description: Raw YAML frontmatter from the page file.

PermissionLevel.description: Enum representing the possible permission levels for a tool.

ProviderMetadata.description: Metadata about a provider's configuration requirements and capabilities

allows_unlisted_models.description: Whether this provider allows entering model names not in the fetched list

default_model.description: The default/recommended model for this provider

display_name.description: Display name for the provider in UIs

known_models.description: A list of currently known models with their capabilities

model_doc_link.description: Link to the docs where models can be found

name.description: The unique identifier for this provider

RetryConfig.description: Configuration for retry logic in workflow execution

checks.description: List of success checks to validate workflow completion

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts before giving up

on_failure.description: Optional shell command to run on failure for cleanup

on_failure_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for on_failure commands (default: 600 seconds)

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for individual shell commands (default: 300 seconds)

max_runs.description:
Optional cap on total firings. When `Some(n)`, the job auto-pauses once
`run_count` reaches `n` — the bound that keeps `/loop` from running
forever. `None` = unbounded (durable `/schedule` jobs).

run_count.description: Number of times this job has fired. Used to enforce `max_runs`.

accumulated_total_tokens.description:
Lifetime totals: the sum of every turn's usage, i.e. tokens actually
processed and billed. They grow without bound and overflowed `i32` at
~2.1e9 — in release that wraps *negative* and then subtracts from the
insights `SUM`. SQLite's INTEGER is already 64-bit.

diverged_from.description:
Id of the session this one was diverged (branched) from, if any. Set by
`diverge_session`; `None` for normally-created sessions. Lets the UI show
a session's lineage ("branched from …").

total_tokens.description:
The *current* turn's usage — the live context-window occupancy. Bounded by
the model's context limit, so `i32` is safe.

sessions.description: List of available session information objects

SessionModelUsageResponse.description: Per-model token breakdown for one session.

models.description:
One row per `(model, provider)` group; a `null` `modelId` is the
"unknown" bucket (turns recorded before model attribution, or providers
that reported no model).

SidecarState.description: Lifecycle state of the managed llama-server process.

SidecarStatus.description:
Snapshot of the sidecar consumed by the GUI onboarding card, settings and
`biorouter doctor`.

context_size.description:
Context window the running model actually exposes (read live from the
server), or `None` until it is ready. Tracks the model, not a preset.

detail.description: Most recent log line (download progress, load stage) or error tail.

model.description: Friendly model name (catalog name or raw HF spec) currently requested.

model_path.description:
Local model blob path used for the running process, if an Ollama model
store hit was available.

model_source.description:
`ollama` when launched from an Ollama model blob, otherwise
`huggingface`.

ollama_name.description: Ollama model name checked first, when this is a catalog model.

warmed.description:
True only after Biorouter has received a non-empty completion from this
model in this process.

oneOf.description: Execute a shell command and check its exit status

SuccessCheck.description: A single success check to validate workflow completion

accumulatedInputTokens.description:
Lifetime totals. `i64` because they grow without bound over a long
session; `i32` wrapped negative at ~2.1e9.

ToolInfo.description: Information about the tool used for building prompts

domain.description: Preferred domain for the app (used for CORS)

prefersBorder.description: Whether the app prefers to have a border around it

name.description: Updated name for the session (max 200 characters)

userWorkflowValues.description: Workflow parameter values entered by the user

from.description:
Echoed resolved window bounds (unix seconds), so the client can render
the exact range it got even when it sent no `from`/`to`.

UsageReportRow.description:
One bucket of the usage report.

`date` is present unless grouping by [`UsageGroup::Model`]; `modelId` is
present unless grouping by [`UsageGroup::Day`]. `cost` is the dollar cost of
the priced turns in the bucket, or `None` when *every* contributing turn was
unpriced (an unknown model) — a `null` cost never means "$0". `hasUnpriced`
flags a bucket that mixes priced and unpriced turns, so a day cost can be
read as "at least this much" rather than exact.

UsageSummary.description: Month-to-date and all-time usage totals, for the summary gauge.

dollarPercent.description:
MTD cost as a percent of the dollar limit; `null` when no limit is set or
the MTD cost is unknown (some models are unpriced).

monthlyDollarLimit.description: Configured monthly dollar budget, or `null` when unset.

monthlyTokenLimit.description: Configured monthly token allowance, or `null` when unset.

tokenPercent.description: MTD tokens as a percent of the token limit; `null` when no limit is set.

UsageTotals.description: Token + cost totals for a time span, priced through [`model_cost`].

cost.description:
Dollar cost of the priced turns, or `None` when nothing in the span is
priced. Priced-but-partial spans return the priced sum with
`has_unpriced = true`.
